question: The National Savings (Monthly Income Account) Scheme, 2019 has been amended through ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4 **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The National Savings (Monthly Income Account) Scheme, 2019 was amended through the National Savings (Monthly Income Account) (Amendment) Scheme, 2023.
 
• The amendment increased the maximum investment limit for the scheme, effective April 1, 2023:
 
• Single account: The maximum investment limit increased from ₹450,000 to ₹900,000
 
• Joint account: The maximum investment limit increased from ₹900,000 to ₹1,500,000 
 
• Other changes to the scheme include:
 
• Interest rates on small savings schemes, except for Savings Deposit and PPF, were revised upwards 
 
• The National Savings (Monthly Income Account) Scheme has the following features:
 
• The account matures in five years
 
• The minimum deposit is ₹1,000, and the maximum is ₹900,000 for a single account and ₹1,500,000 for a joint account
 
• A depositor can open more than one account under the scheme
 
• A guardian can open an account for a minor or a person of unsound mind
 
• An account can be closed prematurely after one year, but before three years, with a deduction of 2% of the deposit
 
• If an account is closed after three years, 1% of the deposit will be deducted
